the development of a virtual reality based preoperative planning system for plastic and breast reconstructive surgery.
the development of a system for breast reconstruction that is both intuitive and accurate.

the use of a physically-based framework for model fitting can provide a more accurate and intuitive way to fit deformable models to patient specific breast surface data than the use of a purely statistical approach.
